In the name of Employment agency services, they provide consultancy services to place a candidate with domestic or overseas employer. Means they provide Job offer to required candidates across the state of Tamil Nadu, India & even abroad(Primarily they say Singapore). Is it for free ? Obviously not. Now you are scared right ? You should. That’s how scams run. They collect upfront fees for overseas job. They collect up to 5 lakhs, may be even more. Depends on the candidate, their Psychology, their emergency need etc. If the candidate is more urgent they will try to collect as much as possible. Remember that any job agency who are collecting upfront fees without a job offer, visa etc.. is most probably a scam barring very few. Just in their company letter head they give a assurance that they have collected money. After certain point of time, Candidates given money would be begging for refund. They keep telling candidates to wait, wait & the wait continues. After certain point of time the candidates ask for a refund from Diraa HR services or Diraa Consultancy Services. They try to convince you and delay further. Then if the candidate is pressurizing more, they do only 20% refund or even less. There is no hard & fast rule. They keep delaying for months, year or more. Still many people had not got the full refund & still begging for refund. Obviously its their hard earned money that people are loosing. After putting huge stress on the people they try to manipulate that they had already done the refund. You will be heartbroken by this time if you are a candidate. But that’s how they do. Even if they return after a year, just calculate the interest that they would be earning. Simple Mathematics : Assume they are collecting Rs 5, 00, 000 from 100 members in an year 5, 00, 000 * 100 = 5, 00, 00000 Say risk free interest rate is 7% / annum. For an year they would be earning 5, 00, 00000 * 7% = Rs 35, 00, 000 (35 Lakhs) approximately. They earn this 35 Lakhs INR just via interest. Remember there are lot of candidates still awaiting for refund and few have left asking. What do you say ? Left the money with them ? Yes ! But why ? Why because if you raise the voice they will start threatening you. You should think how they operate this business model with ease ? Obviously they should have proper political backup or some legal connections too to threaten you. And Psychologically if your money is with them you will try to go smooth until you get back right ? They take massive advantage of that. But how to address these complaints ? God only knows ! Where they operate ? Is Diraa HR Services at Singapore ? Chennai ? All are fabricated false reviews written by their own people. They report and delete the negative reviews & they post positive reviews themselves. You can see some negative reviews by sorting by least reviews of course. Please open your eyes and read those negative reviews given by people & also see how Diraa threaten them in the replies. Always they manage and maintain above 4.5 rating. Title/Headline: Bajaj Finserv — an open letter
Full Text:
Bajaj Finserv User ID: 13524097
I am writing this for the attention of Bajaj Finserv Limited patrons, directors, managers, employees and most importantly the consumers. The past few days since I got an incredible offer from Bajaj Finserv Lending has been very frustrating, unquestionably annoying and logic defying. It’s high time we raise our voice against such unethical behaviors of these big giant companies who are a part of every individual of the country. We see a large number o[censored]nsatisfied consumers of which many are helpless as they have better work to do and hence neglect the undoing. Trusting a company who was recently in news for fraud activities by senior officials was my bad luck, but we all know its human nature that it does not affect us until we experience it. Here’s my story, 
I see in my account an offer of a pre-approved loan and I showed my interest for an obvious reason that I was really in need of one. I get a call from a gentleman who informed me that because of my ‘good track record’ with Bajaj they are offering me a loan of Rs. 377000 at a rate of 1.35% flat interest over a period of 5 years with a monthly instalment of Rs. 11300 approximately. The gentleman didn’t seem to be gentle as he hung up the phone as soon I started questioning to clear myself on rate of interest, its duration and few more questions that I had in mind. I believe his work was done and probably that’s how much he is paid for. I didn’t get angry since I saw a ray of hope. I called the customer care and cleared all doubts. The flat rate of interest seemed to be very high but then when your necessity is even greater you are helpless, hence you ask them to start with the process. I was informed that they will require 4 blank cheque leaves, one cancelled cheque, a passport size photograph, an address proof and a proof of identification. How about an income proof? Well that was not required as this is a pre-approved loan. Two days later a representative named Savinay comes and collects the documents with 5 cheque leaves which I later confirmed with the customer care that he should have taken only four and was directed to write an email to [protected]@bajajfinserv.in. I did so but the excess cheque taken hasn’t been returned yet. I am still anxiously waiting and not yet angry. Next working day another representative came to my place for physical verification, asked me relevant questions and left. Next I got a call from another person for office verification and I informed that I work in an evening shift and can be available only then and at this, the representative informed that he will get someone to come to my house for the office verification as it’s not his working hours. I waited but nobody turned up hence I called the customer care the next day and was informed by them that my loan was pending approval. Cibil is clear and its pending only due to the office verification. Delayed by a week someone came for the office verification at my place and the next day when I called the customer care they no longer cared. I was informed that my loan was rejected and that they do not know the reason. They keep all the information about us, I never had to give any details when I called them. They knew who I am probably pulled the records from the mobile number I called from, but they do not have any information on why the loan got rejected. I was informed that I’ll be intimated in 24 hours. I am still waiting for the intimation, I rechecked the dictionary what intimation means, but I was unfortunate. I was starting to get angry. I wrote an email to [protected]@bajajfinserv.in and [protected]@bajajfinserv.in explaining them what happened and asking them for the reason behind the disapproval. I understand that there are so many credit policies, it could have been for any reason but I have a right to know why. I received a reply the next day stating “With reference to your below mail, we regret to inform you that your personal loan application is rejected in line with our credit policy stating employment stability criteria not meet.
Further, we wish to inform you that pre-approved loan is offered to existing consumer durable customers basis previous credit history. However final personal loan approval decision is based on our credit parameters.”
Now I knew the reason so I tried to explain them by writing another email. I asked a question what exactly the employment stability criteria is and I tried to explain that I am 24 years old graduate with a work experience of 30 months. I understand that I am working in my current organization for last eight months, but the reason I left my previous organization was because I was laid off as the process was shut down. I now work for a verification company and as per my knowledge, if we are laid off due to downsizing that does not hold a negative impact on our profile, moreover I didn’t stop earning for a single month. When the representative came to my place for the office verification he asked me irrelevant questions like how many rooms do I have, what is the rent that I pay and how many earning members are we which was asked by the person who came for address verification. He probably forgot that he came for the office verification. He never asked me why did I leave my last organization since I did tell him that my total experience is of 30 months. I mentioned “I would like to raise this issue further so kindly guide me whom should I email it to if you cannot help it. You say that the final personal loan approval decision is based on your credit parameters and trust me I have fulfilled them all.”
I received a call in a day’s time from a lady informing me that my loan is rejected and that is how it stand. She tried to convince me with a monotonous speech which I declined to accept then and it is unacceptable as of today. After a while I received a reply to my second email which joked “With reference to our discussion, we regret to inform you that we are unable to process your loan application in line with our credit policy stating negative area and employment stability norms not meet.” And they assured me of their best services always in the signature field. Well though not the best but quite an experience I must say. 
Now their sentence had just one change. There was another reason added. I have three credit cards issued where I stay now and Bajaj has provided four consumer loans and now they realize that I stay in a negative area. The laughter that evolves when you are frustrated is something you would definitely like.
Anger grew and to calm that I received another call the same day and this time a lady who spoke a little better than the previous one tried to explain the same thing but instead this time it was myself who explained her about their claims, my stability, and the joke that I stay in a negative area. She empathized and assured that it will be looked up again after I explained her all that I stated above. When I did not see any intimation again I wrote another email and to my shock I received a reply that stated “With reference to our discussion, we regret to inform you that we are unable to process your loan application in line with our credit policy.” 

If anyone at Bajaj Finserv Limited ever read the fair practices code point number 2 that explains their key commitments approved by the board of directors on 15 May 2013. I understand it’s a long time and hard to remember. I tried to relate my experience on these principle and see where they stand.

2. Key Commitments
The Company's key commitments to customers:
a. Act fairly and reasonably in all their dealings with customers by:
•	Meeting the commitments and standards in this Code, for the products and services the Company offers and in the procedures and practices its staff follows.
“I do not know what procedures and practices your staff has been asked to follow but I’m pretty sure commitments and standards failed.”
•	Making sure that Company's products and services meet relevant laws and regulations
“I’m no one to comment on this. I am hopeful respect the laws and regulation.”
•	Company's dealings with customers will rest on ethical principles of integrity and transparency.
Ethical principles of integrity and transparency! I like the idea but it’s high time (almost two years now) you take an effort to adopt it. 
And by the way integrity means “The quality of being honest and having strong moral principles; moral uprightness.” 
And transparency means “as used in science, engineering, business, the humanities and in a social context more generally, implies openness, communication, and accountability.”
b. Help customers understand how company's product work by:
•	Explaining their financial implications.
“This is something I may not expect from Bajaj Finserv for another decade. The staffs lack knowledge, proper training and communicating ability.”
c. Deal quickly and sympathetically with things that go wrong by:
•	Correcting mistakes quickly.
“To correct your mistakes you first need to admit it. Office verification was substandard. By claiming that the loan was rejected due to employment stability, you should have stick to it answered me when I explained my job experience and not by adding another reason which was an insult to the locality I stay in. You called it a negative area. You lied, and when do people Lie?”
•	Handling customer's complaints quickly.
“It’s been twenty days and this mess has not been cleaned.”
•	Telling customers' how to take their complaint forward if they are still not satisfied.
In one of email I asked “I would like to raise this issue further so kindly guide me whom should I email it to if you cannot help it.” I got no acknowledgement whatsoever on this.
d. Publicize this Code, put it on Company's website and have copies available for customer on request. 
“Publicizing the code does not mean you are endorsing it.”
Don’t you think you need to be clear with the requirements and then offer such services? What was the use of one year relationship with your company? Didn’t you come up with the pre-approved loan basis the payment I was making i.e. Rs. 7845 from January 2014 to June 2014. Rs. 9969 from July 2014 to August 2014. Rs. 8944 from September 2014 to October 2014 and Rs. 2944 since then? What if I would have told you I have been working in my current organization since 3 years? You never asked me for any document relating to my work or income. Don’t you think it’s time to grow up and rationalize your theories?

By creating all these mess you also messed up with my cibil report. You say that pre-approved loan is offered to existing consumer durable customer’s basis previous credit history. However final personal loan approval decision is based on your credit parameters so why wasn't I informed about these parameter when I was being informed about all other parameters or before taking the cheques. Again this would mean it could just have been some targets that you wanted to meet and that's why I was kept in dark. Now this also implies that you have certainly messed up with my cibil enquiries. This is really unacceptable. I am in need and due to your unpredictable expedition my chances of getting a loan elsewhere are zero because of the recent inquiry you must have made. The reason you gave was insupportable hence to cover that the way you hypocritically added another reason of the area I stay being negative showed your dishonesty with your own key commitments. It might just be a business for you, but we ask for your service when there is a necessity. You really think you can insult someone’s credibility. Don’t you think making false promises and making fake reasoning is unethical? 

You played a game, wasted my time, messed up with my credit eligibility and then just sit back and relax. I don’t have to remind the last email that I received from you as stated above. I asked for acknowledgment, reason and resolution. You provided none.

Thank you for the consumer durable loans provided by you to the applicant who is the resident of the area which falls under negative parameters. Was this information helpful? No (0) Yes (0)

If you have more info of this company or companies under Cobra Group / DS-Max, add it here as they seem to be running rampant all over Jobstreet, conning degree holders from Law to Engineering fresh grads. Sadly, these people think they are doing a great job, where in fact they are earning  money and being brainwashed day in day out. From Wikipedia (Credits: Polaris) » Click to show Spoiler - click again to hide... «QUOTE Cobra slash DS MAX is in wikipedia, their infamous ways are well known all over the world. http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DS-MAX One of the most common complaints about DS-Max affiliated companies is in their recruiting and advertising practices. Often the position is advertised as an "entry level management position", and claims to operate in any number of glamorous, competitive, high profile, industries ranging from pro sports and entertainment to 4 star restaurants and world travel, when in reality the position is that of a door-to-door salesperson who peddles pizza coupons, discount baseball tickets, 5 dollar umbrellas, designer knock-off hand bags, and travel alarm clocks, none of which the applicant will actually discover until they are out "in the field" with a distributor on their "second interview". A common interviewing formula used by the independent sales offices consists of: 1. A very short first round interview conducted in the office of the manager. Typically in this interview the manager will briefly outline the structure of the business to the potential new distributor. A typical DS-Max manager will interview anywhere from 10 to 30 people a day so this first interview is usually short on detail and any prolonged question and answer sessions are avoided if possible. 2. A full day "second interview" in the sales field where the potential distributor shadows a current distributor while they attempt to sell their products or services door-to-door. This full day interview is an attempt to show the potential distributor how a typical day in the field works. This full day interview, like the first interview is purposefully vague on details and most questions are not answered fully or more difficult questions get passed on to the manager/owner to handle during the final interview. This is known within DS-MAX circles as the "Day of Observation" or the "Day of O". 3. A "final interview" takes place in the manager's office when the potential distributor returns after a full day in the field. If the applicant has any problems or objections, the manager may attempt to overturn them. If the potential distributor needs some clarification in order to understand the "big picture" of this business opportunity the manager will attempt to explain the business beyond just selling products door-to-door. The goal of every manager is to encourage the interviewee to start full time the very next day. The name DS-Max is often used to refer to the whole distribution system that includes DS-Max USA Inc., its affiliated suppliers and independent offices. Each affiliated sales office is an independent and incorporated business. This legal separation between the DS-Max supplying organizations and each individual office insulates DS-Max from any legal or financial liability should something happen within an individual office. Because all sales offices are independently owned and operated each individual distributor and manager/owner reaps the rewards of and is both financially and legally responsible for his own business. The majority of all distributors work as independent contractors and thus are not paid a salary, receive no health benefits and are responsible for paying their own taxes. The DS-Max system runs similarly to network marketing businesses but with several key differences: 1) Sales representatives (distributors) generally work full-time (often six days, 60 hours or more a week), relying on their sales for their primary source of income, rather than a slow transition from part-time to full-time. 2) The individual owner assumes the cost and advertises for new distributors and finds a mentor for them, rather than the distributor absorbing the cost of recruiting. 3) Distributors receive the products on consignment rather than paying for them up front and there is no fee for becoming a distributor. The business only grows when new distributors are added. While DS-Max as a whole has grown quite large through the years, the vast majority of distributors and managers in affiliated distribution operations in the DS-Max system have not enjoyed success. In the 20 plus years of operation the Ds-max business model has generated some tremendous success for a small group of Vice-Presidents, or as they are referred to now, National Consultants, but the question of how many have found success in Ds-max compared to the number who have attempted to achieve success can only be answered by analyzing accurate, detailed records of these organizations and their affiliates. However the nature of their operations make it unlikely that such documentation exists. Later I couldn;t locate him on phone and HSBC Andheri intimated me that it is 25 lakhs which are required for premier account else I will be penalised. Second phase of trouble starts once you have opened account: [protected][protected][protected]------ 2) There is no one to answer your querry, all that you would talk to is telephone banking agents, who would just note down the message but no coordination with their operations. You will not hear from them NO MATTER HOW MANY TIMES YOU CALL THEM SITTING OVERSEAS. 3) Telephone banking sucks, you can;t really do any transaction with them. you can;t get your issues fixed as the messages you leave with them get trashed. 4) You cannot transfer your money among your joint account, there is restriction, which is unwarranted or unexplained. 5) There are unknown and arbitrary FCY charges which are never explained. 6) If you are back to your work country outside India, you cannot use your account by any means, unless you leave your checks with your friends or relatives in India. 7) There are high conversion charges when you use debit card overseas. You loose lot of money. 8) The statement will come to you 2 months after it being printed. It is delayed by so many days or week when it actually hits the post office for further delivery to your address. 9) HSBC NRI services will paste less amount of postal stamp so either your delivery will be delayed or you will never get the post from them. IN my case actual stamp required was 25 Rs but the stamp pasted was only Rs 20. Moreover letter hit franking machine ( with insufficient amount of stamp) after 1 month of its issue date. 10) My account became dormant though necessary transactions were taken place. However it was only 1 or 2 transactions which I could make in year. But as per official records dormant status is posted only if there are no transactions for 2 years. I made transaction in Oct 2008 but the dormant status was showing till December 2008. The account can only be lablelled inactive if it has not done any transaction for one year. The information of account being so called "dormant" was received by me after two months. Total confusion and distortion of real facts. There is no one to hear you. But most HSBC NODAL OFFICE, vice president Nri services are unaware of diffrentiation between "dormant" and "inactive" words. The only good thing about HSBC is they have internet banking ( which is unusable for any transaction) except for paying bills, coupled with tall claims like " you will be treated in priority" for premier accounts. 11) Be ready to face their staff or tele banking agents who are just high school or university dropouts. 12) If you happen to visit their branch in Andheri or any other place be prepared to answer irrelevant questions by novice who are working with little knowledge about banking. 13) Be prepared to receive canned and automated messages which will not help you, but will keep you in indifinate trap. You cannot get any intelligent human factor to help you . So there is no point writing or emailing to them sitting 10000 kms away from home branch. Only good thing about HSBC bank is neatly dressed staff with ties, with the word " Sorry" & " I apologise" while being ignorant of anything across the table or phone. Their training is all about ranting the words Sorry and I apologise. I have forwarded my complaint to President Hsbc and Nodal officer so many times, but there is no proper response. So if you want to loose your time and money please use HSBC NRI SERVICES, or just be on your own once you deposit or transfer your money. You can withdraw your money with great hardship only when you visit India. Your money is struck and there is no one to answer you. So just be careful before considering to open account with HSBC NRI SERVICES. AVOID THEM, OR LOOSE YOUR TIME AND ENERGY. YOU CAN'T BE DOING JUSTICE WITH YOUR MONEY IF YOU DEAL WITH THEM. THEY HAVE SO MANY WAYS TO TRAP YOU, EVEN TO ILLEGALLY MAKE YOUR ACCOUANT DORMANT AND KEEP YOU UNINFORMED. THEIR COMMUNICATION TAKES 2 MONTHS TO REACH YOU. SO JUST BE-AWARE... OR GET A BURDEN FOR LIFE TIME. HSBC NRI SERVICES REALLY SUCKS... USE OTHER BANKS SO THAT YOU ARE SAFE IN TERMS OF PEACE OF MIND AND VALUE FOR YOUR OWN MONEY.

Title/Headline: Saurabh Verma Dealmaster Code — Biggest fraud stay away from saurabh verma (Dealmaster code) saurabh verma (Dealmaster code) is the biggest fraud total scam !
Full Text: This is a real experience and a serious warning to others: I joined a program led by Saurabh Verma, founder of something called Dealmaster Code, after seeing his marketing on WhatsApp and ads promising access to ChatGPT+ and 40+ premium AI tools. He charged ₹10, 000 upfront with claims that: You will get lifetime access to ChatGPT Plus 40+ advanced AI tools with premium version Learn laser-focused WhatsApp marketing Get full recordings and support Earn up to ₹10 Lakh/month by using these tools All of this sounded exciting and useful. But after payment, the reality was completely different. ❌ What Actually Happened Day 1: We were added to a Zoom session with many participants He spoke mostly in motivational language and gave no tool access Promised tool access “after setup” but gave nothing Day 2: More talk, zero delivery. Again, no login credentials, no premium tools, just hype. He kept saying, “Setup complete, now you will get access, ” but again, nothing happened. Day 3: The biggest shock: Instead of giving promised tools or support, he started demanding ₹1, 00, 000 extra He said: “If you want to earn ₹10 Lakh per month, you must invest ₹1 Lakh right now.” No real AI tool, no system, nothing was given before this demand Day 3 recording was not even shared (probably because it exposes the truth) 🔍 Why This is a Scam ❌ False promises before payment ❌ No actual AI tool or premium access ever delivered ❌ Manipulation with emotional language and urgency ❌ Hiding comments on YouTube to avoid being exposed ❌ Demanding large sums (₹1 Lakh) after initial trap ❌ No real support, no refund, and no accountability Many people in the webinar got emotionally influenced thinking: "If I just get access to the premium AI tools, I’ll earn big money." But he uses this hope to trap innocent learners, students, and job-seekers. 📹 No Transparency – YouTube Trick His YouTube channel has only 3-4 carefully made videos Comments are turned off so that nobody can post the truth No proof, no testimonials from real users — just filtered marketing 🎯 Conclusion: Please Don’t Fall for This Trap I lost my hard-earned ₹10, 000 to this fraud. He did not deliver even 5% of what he promised. Now he asks for even more, using manipulation and emotional pressure. ✅ There are no real AI tools, no business system, and no results. ✅ This is a well-designed scam dressed like a high-level coaching program. ✅ He is cheating people under the name of “Dealmaster Code”. 🚨 Final Warning: If you are thinking about joining this program, DON’T DO IT. Please share this review with your friends, groups, or on WhatsApp — so that others don’t lose money like I did. We must expose Saurabh Verma and prevent him from cheating more people. Title/Headline: Sas India Trainings (bandra) & Telus International — complaint against sas india trainings (bandra) and fraudulent "telus international" scam
Full Text: Respected Sir/Madam, I am writing to formally lodge a complaint against SAS India Trainings (Bandra) and a fraudulent entity impersonating Telus International, who scammed me out of ₹15, 999 under the pretense of a job offer. Below are the detailed aspects of the scam: Details of the Scam: Fraudulent Representation: I was contacted by individuals posing as representatives of Telus International for a job opportunity as a Data Analyst. They used fake email IDs designed to mimic the official Telus International domain, making the communication appear authentic. The emails were sent from: kirti.[protected]@teluslnternational.in kapil.[protected]@teluslnternational.in These fake domains replaced the uppercase "I" in "International" with a lowercase "l", making it visually indistinguishable from the legitimate domain. This deliberate manipulation of the domain was used to deceive job seekers like me into trusting the fraudulent emails. Collusion with SAS India Trainings (Bandra): The fake HR team of "Telus International" informed me that I needed to undergo a mandatory training program offered by their "partner, " SAS India Trainings (Bandra), in order to secure the position. I was directed to pay ₹15, 999 for this training through the website https://sasindiatrainings.com/. The contact person at SAS India Trainings was Aditya, reachable at [protected]. I was assured by both parties that the training fee would be reimbursed with my first salary. HR Round and MCQ Test: As part of the process, the first round was conducted as an HR round via Microsoft Teams, where I was interviewed. During the interview, I was asked to take an MCQ test on SAP, which I completed. At that time, I believed the process was genuine, and the company seemed legitimate. Payment and Fake Offer Letter: I made the payment and received an invoice from SAS India Trainings. After the payment, I was issued an offer letter from the fraudulent Telus International, which I later discovered was counterfeit. Professional Scam Operation: The fake HR and hiring manager were highly professional in their approach, making the scam extremely convincing. Their contact details are: HR Department: +91 [protected] Hiring Manager: +91 [protected] No Job or Reimbursement: Despite completing the process and making the payment, I did not receive any legitimate job offer or the promised reimbursement. Attempts to follow up with SAS India Trainings and the fake Telus International representatives have been ignored. Supporting Evidence: Email correspondence from the fraudulent Telus International team (from the manipulated domain). Payment screenshot and invoice from SAS India Trainings. The fake offer letter provided by the fraudulent Telus International. My Request: Immediate Investigation: I request the forum to investigate SAS India Trainings (Bandra), specifically Aditya (mobile: [protected]), and the fraudulent Telus International entity for their role in this scam. Refund of Fees: I demand a full refund of ₹15, 999, which was collected under false pretenses. Legal Action and Awareness: The involved parties must face legal consequences, and awareness should be raised to prevent others from falling victim to similar scams. Contact Information: Name: Shubham Hajare Contact Number: +91 [protected] Email: [protected]@gmail.com I am ready to provide any additional details or documentation required to support this complaint. Please let me know the next steps to take this matter forward. Thank you for your time and assistance. Sincerely, Shubham Hajare Was this information helpful? No (0) Yes (0)

Title/Headline: Pooja Gupta Deloitte [protected] — Pooja Gupta ([protected]) Working At Deloitte, Cheated Indian Entrepreneur For 28.5 Lacs
Full Text: A 36-year-old Indian Entrepreneur has filed a complaint with Noida Police accusing a woman and her mother of duping him of over 28.5 Lacs via matrimony fraud. The 34-year-old woman, identified as Pooja Gupta, residing at House no.2260, Phase-7, Mohali, SAS Nagar-160059, Punjab with her mother Promila Gupta, who was also part of this matrimony fraud, allegedly defrauded a UK-based NRI and Entrepreneur of Rs 28.5 Lacs on the pretext of marriage. The NRI Fintech professional has lodged a complaint with the District Court, under section-154(b) of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 for the matrimony fraud. The 36-year-old entrepreneur established his claim to the court with several proofs from voice calls, Whatsapp chats from the Indian Number “[protected]”; Several marriage photographs, Hotel bookings done by Pooja Gupta from her debit and credit card on several occasions to lured him by her “Honey Trap” from 2017 till November 2019. In 2017, Pooja Gupta met this Indian entrepreneur on the context of marriage through online dating app, while he was married and had a child. Pooja Gupta started to provoke him for a year to separate him from his wife and child and enforced an obligatory clause for not honoring the biological child with no rights to meet the child ever. In 2019, finally the District Court of Saket, New Delhi accepted the divorce petition and soon after the grant of Divorce; Pooja Gupta started digging money from the entrepreneur on different context for 2 years. Soon after the divorce, Pooja Gupta quickly got married to the entrepreneur in a Hindu Mandir at Delhi with a simple marriage ceremony, keeping it almost a tight-lipped affair and started to live with him on and off by booking several 5 star hotels in Delhi, Noida and Gurgoan and also at his residence at Sector 137 Noida without disclosing this to her family and friends for few months. The entrepreneur did published several booking vouchers in front with the court and on further investigating the case by the local police, they discovered several CCTV footage from the entrepreneurs society camers’s and from various five star hotels as well as the booking vouchers submitted by the victim to the District court. In late 2020, Pooja Gupta expressed the entrepreneur that her family needs Rs.28.5 Lacs help on the account of some family dispute at Chandigarh and assured him to refund the money in 3 months timeline. After extracting the money, she became incommunicado. The NRI called her mother and realized it was a complete “Honey Trap” by Promila Gupta and her daughter Pooja Gupta. The mother Promila Gupta threated the entrepreneur and said she holds good connection with Police and Judges. The NRI realized that he had been duped following which he filed a police complaint with Local Police as well as with the District Court against Promila Gupta & Pooja Gupta. After the incedent came in limelight, FIR is registered under Section 120B, 420, 421, 406, 506 and 495 of Indian Penal Code on the account of the seriousness of the crime. Police is further investigating the angle of habitual tendency of the Mother Daughter Duo to extort money by making new traps through publishing ads at matrimonial websites. It is now a matter of investigation that Pooja Gupta has married to how many number of people by this similar “HoneyTrap” and how many were reported in past. From the sources, Pooja Gupta works with ‎Deloitte India (Offices of the US) as senior consultant, technically sound with Oracle cloud financials and uses several dating’s apps like Bumble, Jeevansathi, Tinder and many more to ploy rich qualified male bachelors. Furthermore, Section 494 of the IPC is also added to the ongoing FIR for Bigamy & Adultery where in Pooja Gupta is already married and cheating on her current husband and State demanded for 5 years of imprisonment for both the Mother Daughter Duo. Astonishingly the father of Pooja Gupta, Mr.Raj Kumar Gupta, a resident of Phase-7, Mohali Chandigarh is also allegedly for defrauding another victim Mr.Rajsh for Rs.1.20 Crore in a similar context and the case is now passed on to the Economic Offences Wing of Chandigarh Police at sector 17 due to the criminal severity and is been monitored by the Offices of Superintendent of Police, Chandigarh "Prima facie, the girl duped the man in context of holding wife’s position and run away with the money. FIR is registered however no arrests have been made so far. Said the Local Police officials. Title/Headline: Jet Airways — Pilots Cheating For Medical Tests and Compromising safety
Full Text:
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 I am a frequent flyer who travels quite frequently domestically and internationally. I was witness to a shocking conversation involving pilots.
 When I had recently travelled overseas and was at a very popular mall……..while I was waiting in a coffee shop (Waiting for my wife to finish her shopping). Several gentlemen of Indian origin came to the same coffee shop. It was evident with their conversation that they are Pilots of Jet Airways a leading airline in India. Except for two pilots the others left to do some shopping in the mall, the two pilots who stayed back, from their conversation, I could make out that apparently one is a senior (commander) & the other a first officer, started conversing in Kannada, a language that I understand and speak very fluently (I could not help but overhear as they were sitting very very close to me were quite loud). Either they were oblivious to the fact that another Indian is sitting in the next table or they assumed by my very distinctive Non Indian looks & appearance that I cannot speak Kannada, or maybe they simply did not care as they are in a foreign country and have assumed that maybe people cannot understand Kannada.
The first officer supposedly had his medical/fitness test in a few weeks & was confiding with the commander that he was apprehensive & skeptical about clearing the same as his cholesterol levels were high and he had certain other issues. What shocked me was…..the senior pilot rather than put sense into the junior's head suggested he take some pills that will thin the blood or show reduced cholesterol levels during the medical test and also assured him that he will pass his medical/fitness test with flying colors if he listens and does exactly what the commander says, The commander was boasting that this is what he & most of the pilots in India have been doing for ages and that there are many techniques to cheat the many tests that are conducted on the pilots, only if they ever do a random check he will definitely fail or get caught and that he has resorted to cheating the system for ages rather than comply with the guidelines. The senior pilot seemed to have a solution for every test including alchohol, he was mentioning that there is a drug which will mask alchohol in their blood and he frequently takes the same...Now isn't that scary...
The senior pilot also mentioned that the doctors who perform the test CANNOT BE BRIBED to get clearance, and the only way is to cheat the system rather than take corrective measures/steps.
While I was very very glad to hear that the doctors cannot be bribed, but was shocked that pilots have found a way to cheat the system.
After the discussion about the various parameters of the medical tests and various ways to cheat the same, the topic moved to sex. Both the pilots (from what I overheard were apparently married & with kids too) had employed the services of commercial sex workers the previous night and were sharing their experiences with each other as to how good the experience was and then exchanged the numbers of women & pimps to try out on their next visit. while it’s none of my business to interfere in anyone’s sex life. Aren’t they compromising our national security by sleeping with unknown women? What if they are walking into a honey trap? What if they are blackmailed to smuggle drugs/weapons/bombs on board? What bout diseases like aids? What if they are forced to carry contraband into a foreign country or our own country?
Also aren’t these guys compromising our safety and security, whilst cheating the medical test and flying may seem ok to the pilots, What about us flyer who are at the mercy of these pilots, what if something happens like if one of them has a fatal heart attack while flying. 
Am aware that the job of a Pilot is very very demanding and that they shoulder a lot of responsibilities, What about the lives of hundreds of passengers, what about the multimillion dollar machines that they operate, what about the reputation of our country and the company that they represent, aren’t these important responsibilities as well.
Do they they think that rules should not be applied to them or their families. Do the pilots think they are above the law and invincible.
Hope you will highlight the issues that I have mentioned and expose the pilots to the public. Aren't our lives valuable.


Regards.
An Air Traveller

Title/Headline: Bajaj Allianz — Misleading information and cheating
Full Text: I had taken Bajaj Allianz Super Saver Policy. The agent who contacted me had explained to me that after 5 years there is not going to be any penalty for withdrawal of complete amount. Recently when I went through their policy documents and contacted their customer care I was shocked to find that what has been explained to me is completely different from the policy documents. If I try to cancel the policy now, I will get only 30% of the premiums paid (excluding first year premium). That is I had paid two years of premium which amounts to 1,00,000. So if I surrender policy all I will get is 15,000. I had asked the policy for 10 years and these people had sent the documents for 15 years. Now as per the policy documents if I continue to pay the premium of 50000 till 15 years, at end of 15 years all I can expect is 8,35,200. A mere return of 85,200. An effective rate of return at 1.6% per year. Even savings account earns 4% interest. When I contacted Bajaj Allianz customer care, this is what they had to say regarding surrendering the policy "The Policy can be surrendered after completion of three Policy Years provided first three Years? premiums have been paid in full. The minimum Guaranteed Surrender Value (GSV) will be equal to: GSV = 30% X (Total premiums paid till date less premium paid in the first Year less any extra premiums and additional rider benefit premiums, if any). The Company may also declare a Special Surrender Value (SSV). SSV will be calculated by multiplying SSV factor to the Paid-Up Value, per Section 10, at the time of surrender. The higher of GSV and SSV will be paid as the Surrender Value." I requested them to provide me the SSV factor company has declared for 2011 and 2012 (as policy had started in 2008), they refused to do so. I don't understand why they cannot provide this figure. Has any of you received information regarding the vested bonus announced for super saver policy holders? This policy has to be named super destroyer not super saver. The agent had offered a 2g gold or some other electronic appliance if I take the policy. I came to know that IRDA prohibits this kind of gifts and is illegal. It looks like there are lot of innocent victims like me who have been cheated/mislead/duped into buying this policy from Bajaj Allianz. If you are one such victim and like to take some action please contact me. Collectively we can approach IRDA. I have learned hard way that best insurance policy is pure term insurance policy. It is better to keep investments and insurance as separate. Please contact [protected]@gmail.com

Title/Headline: Pooja Gupta Deloitte [protected] — Pooja Gupta ([protected]) Working At Deloitte, Cheated Indian Entrepreneur For 28.5 Lacs
Full Text: A 36-year-old Indian Entrepreneur has filed a complaint with Noida Police accusing a woman and her mother of duping him of over 28.5 Lacs via matrimony fraud. The 34-year-old woman, identified as Pooja Gupta, residing at House no.2260, Phase-7, Mohali, SAS Nagar-160059, Punjab with her mother Promila Gupta, who was also part of this matrimony fraud, allegedly defrauded a UK-based NRI and Entrepreneur of Rs 28.5 Lacs on the pretext of marriage. The NRI Fintech professional has lodged a complaint with the District Court, under section-154(b) of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 for the matrimony fraud. The 36-year-old entrepreneur established his claim to the court with several proofs from voice calls, Whatsapp chats from the Indian Number “[protected]”; Several marriage photographs, Hotel bookings done by Pooja Gupta from her debit and credit card on several occasions to lured him by her “Honey Trap” from 2017 till November 2019. In 2017, Pooja Gupta met this Indian entrepreneur on the context of marriage through online dating app, while he was married and had a child. Pooja Gupta started to provoke him for a year to separate him from his wife and child and enforced an obligatory clause for not honoring the biological child with no rights to meet the child ever. In 2019, finally the District Court of Saket, New Delhi accepted the divorce petition and soon after the grant of Divorce; Pooja Gupta started digging money from the entrepreneur on different context for 2 years. Soon after the divorce, Pooja Gupta quickly got married to the entrepreneur in a Hindu Mandir at Delhi with a simple marriage ceremony, keeping it almost a tight-lipped affair and started to live with him on and off by booking several 5 star hotels in Delhi, Noida and Gurgoan and also at his residence at Sector 137 Noida without disclosing this to her family and friends for few months. The entrepreneur did published several booking vouchers in front with the court and on further investigating the case by the local police, they discovered several CCTV footage from the entrepreneurs society camers’s and from various five star hotels as well as the booking vouchers submitted by the victim to the District court. In late 2020, Pooja Gupta expressed the entrepreneur that her family needs Rs.28.5 Lacs help on the account of some family dispute at Chandigarh and assured him to refund the money in 3 months timeline. After extracting the money, she became incommunicado. The NRI called her mother and realized it was a complete “Honey Trap” by Promila Gupta and her daughter Pooja Gupta. The mother Promila Gupta threated the entrepreneur and said she holds good connection with Police and Judges. The NRI realized that he had been duped following which he filed a police complaint with Local Police as well as with the District Court against Promila Gupta & Pooja Gupta. After the incedent came in limelight, FIR is registered under Section 120B, 420, 421, 406, 506 and 495 of Indian Penal Code on the account of the seriousness of the crime. Police is further investigating the angle of habitual tendency of the Mother Daughter Duo to extort money by making new traps through publishing ads at matrimonial websites. It is now a matter of investigation that Pooja Gupta has married to how many number of people by this similar “HoneyTrap” and how many were reported in past. From the sources, Pooja Gupta works with ‎Deloitte India (Offices of the US) as senior consultant, technically sound with Oracle cloud financials and uses several dating’s apps like Bumble, Jeevansathi, Tinder and many more to ploy rich qualified male bachelors. Furthermore, Section 494 of the IPC is also added to the ongoing FIR for Bigamy & Adultery where in Pooja Gupta is already married and cheating on her current husband and State demanded for 5 years of imprisonment for both the Mother Daughter Duo. Astonishingly the father of Pooja Gupta, Mr.Raj Kumar Gupta, a resident of Phase-7, Mohali Chandigarh is also allegedly for defrauding another victim Mr.Rajsh for Rs.1.20 Crore in a similar context and the case is now passed on to the Economic Offences Wing of Chandigarh Police at sector 17 due to the criminal severity and is been monitored by the Offices of Superintendent of Police, Chandigarh "Prima facie, the girl duped the man in context of holding wife’s position and run away with the money. FIR is registered however no arrests have been made so far. Said the Local Police officials. Title/Headline: Pooja Gupta ([protected]) Deloitte — Smitten by her 'Love Chat' Pooja Gupta from Deloitte scams Rs.28.5lacs from an Indian Entrepreneur
Full Text: Less than a month after the FIR is registered against the prime suspect Pooja Gupta & her mother Promila Gupta, local Police is investigating further on the financial crime. The investigating team identified bank transactions from the entrepreneur's bank account, withdrawals, and the CDR file of the mobile number "[protected]" registered under the name of Pooja Gupta & details of telephone calls & other telecommunications transactions like Whatsapp, Instagram, i-messages, etc which eventually matching up with the reported incident. Last week, the victim of the matrimony fraud presented another calls record and WhatsApp chat to establish that the money of Rs.28.5lacs was taken by Pooja Gupta however on call and on WhatsApp chat she referred to it as payment received by her but not directly. The local investigation team hasn’t arrested anyone in this matter, as the police are still trying to gather more critical inputs and scrutinizing the angle of the habitual tendency of the Mother-Daughter Duo to extort money by making new traps through publishing ads at matrimonial websites. Pooja Gupta works with ‎Deloitte India (Offices of the US) as senior consultant, technically sound with Oracle cloud financials and uses several dating’s apps like Bumble, Jeevansathi, Tinder, and many more to ploy rich qualified male bachelors. In 2017, Pooja Gupta met this Indian entrepreneur in the context of marriage through online dating app, while he was married and had a child. Pooja Gupta started to provoke him for a year to separate him from his wife and child and enforced an obligatory clause for not honoring the biological child with no rights to meet the child ever. In 2018, finally the District Court of Saket, New Delhi accepted the divorce petition and soon after the grant of Divorce; Pooja Gupta started digging money from the entrepreneur in a different context for 2 years. Soon after the divorce, Pooja Gupta hurriedly got married to the entrepreneur in a Hindu Mandir at Delhi with a simple marriage ceremony and started to live with him on and off by booking several 5-star hotels in Delhi, Noida, and Gurgoan and also at his residence without disclosing this to her family and friends. The entrepreneur did publish several booking vouchers in front of the court and state police and on further investigating the case by the local police, discovered several CCTV footage from the entrepreneur's residence and from various five star hotels as well as the booking vouchers submitted to the District court. In 2020, Pooja Gupta expressed to the entrepreneur that her family needs Rs.28.5 Lacs help on the account of some family dispute at Chandigarh and assured him to refund the money in 3 months timeline. After extracting the money, she became incommunicado. The Entrepreneur called her mother and realized it was a complete “Honey Trap” by Promila Gupta and her daughter Pooja Gupta. The mother Promila Gupta threatened the entrepreneur and said she holds a good connection with Police and Judges. The victim realized that he had been duped following which he filed a police complaint with Local Police as well as with the District Court against Promila Gupta & Pooja Gupta. After the incident came in limelight, Pooja Gupta & Promila Gupta was booked under IT Act and other relevant sections 120B, 420, 421, 406, 506, and 495 of the Indian Penal Code. "The trademark modus operandi of Pooja Gupta remains Lure, extract money and become incommunicado. We will file a prisoner transit warrant and arrest of Promila Gupta & Pooja Gupta, The local inspector said. Was this information helpful? No (1) Yes (2)

Title/Headline: Flipkart — Gift voucher and Flipkart fraud on all over India
Full Text: The CEO Flipkart Whereas the undersigned on 23rd September, 2022 has placed an Online order with your Company for 7 Items from Grocery Basket for Rs 1, 811/- which amount in a fraction of second was debited from my Account and credited to your Account with an intimation that the same would be delivered by 26th September, 2022. In the morning of 26th September, 2022 message was received that the Order will be shipped soon and will be delivered on that very date. However to my utter shock and surprise at 3.27 P.M, I received the following message; " Order will be returned since order was not accepted during delivery." I immediately wrote back that above message is absolutely false as the same was not delivered, so the question of 'Non Acceptance "does not arise at all. I asked for name of the Delivery Man who came to deliver and also to inform me the name of person who did not accept the delivery. Till now, these relevant information has not been furnished. Be that as it may, thereafter another false story has been propounded by your Company, as at 4.28 P M. on 26th September, 2022 the undersigned got the following message ; " Flipkart cancelled as Couriers could not deliver to your Address." Admittedly, both the above messages contradict each other. In order after having accepting the Cost of Groceries in Advance, you have chosen not to supply the Goods to the Consumer without any Justifiable reason and your Company has been using the Consumer's money for its benefits, which amounts to "Unfair Trade Practices and als Deficiency in Services." Moreover, it would also amount to Fraud and Cheating under Indian Penal Code of 1860 when false and concocted messages have been sent within a span of one hour. Further, the undersigned reserve the right to inform all the Companies about Unfair Trade Practices being indulged by your Company in not supplying their Goods after accepting the Cost in Advance, to the Consumer's. So, the undersigned hereby call upon you to intimate the reason as to why the order was cancelled. In the meantime though the Refund has been received but you are required to suitably Compensate the undersigned for Mental Agony and sufferings caused due to illegal cancellation of the order. Also take note, that in case the issues are not resolved to the satisfaction of the undersigned, then the undersigned will delete your App and will issue Advisory to all its Accuintances ; " Do Online shopping with any Company but Never with FlipKart." Justice V B Gupta (Former Judge High Court of Delhi and Former Judicial Member National Consumer Commission) B-59 FRIENDS COLONY ( WEST) Mathura Road, New Delhi. 110065.

Title/Headline: Flipkart — inb flipkart fraud
Full Text: To, Vp (Sachin bansal, binny bansal), Flipkart india, ltd. Subject: review of return/refund/exchange/replace policy. Dear mr. Bansal, I must say, your customer care staff is a polite but potent firewall. I took me more than two weeks to extract your email id from them. Here is why i am writing to you! I purchased a laptop hp-15au623tx, order od[protected], from flipkart, on 2nd april. It’s a hp pavilion series laptop (I5 7gen 8gbram 4gb graphics; excellent reviews). But when it arrived i found out that this laptop had a fiber body and not the metallic body (As it looked in the images), which i required. So i checked out with hp world store near me and they told me that what i had bought is a pavillion au series laptop and the metallic body laptop is available in pavillion cc series. So i tried to obtain return/exchange on this laptop, which i was denied citing that the seller doesn’t have a return/exchange policy. (Please note, your competitor amazon.com, do have a 3 days return policy on this laptop) now my point is: I bought a branded product (Hp pavilion laptop) from a branded company (Flipkart.com, worth $ 11 billion), then why is this anonymous seller coming into loop. I bought the product on your brand trust, why should i care for your seller or their policy. (Even though i know it’s mentioned in website). Here in my case, evidently i got misled by the images, and ordered the laptop on pretext that it comes in a metallic body (Please also note, even the product description doesn’t describe the body texture and details). Also please note these days laptops come with lots of different models & series. As in my case hp pavilion au series with fiber body and cc series with metal body. So there is every possibility that a customer might make a mistake during an online purchase. And i sincerely believe that you should have some window of return (Even if limited to 2-3 days as with amazon.com) for such costly products. Finally, even if the seller has no exchange/return policy, i think an 11 billion company like flipkart should inculcate some loss bearing capability when it comes to genuine customer request to boost the brand confidence. Remember online buying experience is not always the same as buying from a store and sometimes the customer is bound to make a mistake. And finally hoping that my return/exchange request would be granted, i wish you all the best.

That was the point I realized this was a completely fake and fraudulent organization. •	A trained calling team (mainly women) manipulates and brainwashes job seekers emotionally, dragging them into the trap. This is not a one-time case — I know several victims (some paying 5–6 lakhs) still waiting endlessly or being handed fake offer letters. ⚠️ Shaara Info Developers is running a professional scam, exploiting unemployed youth and job seekers. Don’t fall into their trap. Spread the word. Was this information helpful? No (0) Yes (2)

Title/Headline: HappyEasyGo — refund scam
Full Text: I had booked flights tickets from Goa to Mumbai for 24th March 22:55 pm through the website - Happy Easy Go. Due to the coronavirus pandemic, we had to cancel our flight. In-numerous emails and calls were made - all in vain. No response from their side. As a responsible citizen, we decided to cancel the flight directly through airlines website facing a heavy penalty of 8.7K! - but this was we could get back some amount back. To our bad luck, India went on a lockdown and no flights were operational from 24th March 00:00 am. If we hadn't voluntarily cancelled, we would have automatically gotten the entire amount as refund. Still, we were happy when the airlines informed us that they had processed 2.5k as refund to our agent (Happy easy go) and we would receive it soon via same mode of payment Since March 23rd, after innumerable mails and calls later, today - April 13th ( almost a month later) I was finally able to reach Happy easy go. They informed me rudely that they won't refund anything because they are also charging their own penalty- inr 500 per ticket and inr 1000 in convenience charges?! This whole issue started due to lack of customer support form their end. But ironically they are charging convenience fees and won't even refunded that 2.5k back to us. The worst customer service ever! Super arrogant. And on top of it they fake advertise- 1. My Booking invoice has the word "refundable " on it. 2. They send daily emails claiming "free cancellation" ( literally flooded my inbox ) 3. They say 24*7 customer service ( A big joke) They may have slightly lower price(inr 100-200) while you try to book. DO NOT FALL FOR IT!!! While researching about them I came across multiple complaints of scam. Title/Headline: Government of India — CUSTOM OFFICERS SCAM AT INDIAN AIRPORTS- BRIBE, CORRUPTION
Full Text: A story from a passenger about corruption on Indian Airports. Below is the complaint I filed with the Central Vigilance Commission of India against a corrupt official at the Bangalore International Airport. It was filed on 10th Feb 2008. I have not heard anything from the CVC till date. But, as per their policy (http://www.cvc.nic.in/comp_stat_srch.asp) they take 3 months to generate a report and another 6 months for disciplinary action and another 6 months for imposition of penalty. As of now, I have not received any acknowledgement. ———————————&md... ⇄ Dear Sir/Madam, This is a complaint report against Mr. V. Giridharan - Asst. Customs Officer at Bangalore International Airport and his accomplices. His accomplices at the airport include uniformed customs officials as well as trolley assistants. Here are the complaints against Mr. V. Giridharan: 1. Demanding a bribe from passengers to help them evade customs duty. 2. Harassing passengers who seek to pay the official customs duty and refuse to pay the bribe. 3. Charging customs duty on items that are to be allowed duty-free. Here are the complaints against the trolley assistants that work around the baggage claim area: 1. Forcefully, handling passenger’s baggage without their permissions and causing nuisance to the passengers. 2. Crowding the baggage claim area near the conveyor belt so as to causing inconvenience to the passengers. The detailed complaint and the circumstances are provided below: I arrived at the Bangalore International airport in the first week of January at 840am from San Francisco via Singapore Airlines flight SQ500. I am a professional working in the United States and returning after almost a year. I was carrying with me a brand new Canon Pixma MP210 printer worth Rs. 2800/-. The trolley assistants immediately grabbed my printer from the conveyor without my permissions and pushed me aside to take the printer to the red channel X-Ray. Such behavior by the trolley assistants is condoned by the customs officials and I suspect, is encouraged. I handed over my passport to the customs official (Mr. V. Giridharan) when requested. Mr. Giridharan took one look at the printer and asked me for its value. I told him that the printer is worth US$70 and pointed him to the rate label on the box. Furthermore, I furnished the original purchase receipt for the printer. Mr. Giridharan mentioned that another passenger who had a printer paid him Rs. 700/- and was allowed to go without paying the customs duties and hence I should do the same. I requested that I wish to pay the official customs duty so that I can get a receipt. A noticeably infuriated Mr. Giridharan claimed that he would detain the printer. I insisted that I was not refusing to pay the customs duty but, I would pay money only if I were given an official customs receipt. Mr. Giridharan in turn asked one of his customs officials to frisk all my bags and evaluate if there was anything else to levy a duty on. The other official took an inordinate amount of time get to the bags and instead kept convincing me to just pay up the bribe and proceed out of the airport. A thorough checking of my bags and suitcases revealed that I had no other dutiable items. All this time, my passport was with Mr. Giridharan. He eventually opened up the customs receipt book and wasted time with pointless talk to other people around him while I was patiently waiting to know the duty amount. It was very frustrating for me to have just landed at the airport after a travel of almost 32 hours and having to wait in line for Mr. Giridharan to chit-chat with his fellow officers instead of writing up the receipt. I was able to obtain an official customs receipt after an ordeal of almost 60 minutes since having arrived at the baggage claim. I am shocked, disgusted and humiliated by the blatant corruption by the Customs Officials at the Bangalore International Airport. In fact Mr. Giridharan was pestering a foreign passenger who was waiting in line right after me. Apparently people like Mr. Giridharan have been asking for bribes very openly in front of other passengers and customs officials. In fact, the other customs officials and the trolley assistants seem to be in partnership for the cash cheated out of Government. I request you to take proper punitive actions against Mr. Giridharan. It would be unfair to just complain without providing a few suggestions on how you could help to improve the situation. 1. Please install cameras monitoring the activities of the customs channels and the baggage claim area. That should at the least invoke a fear amongst the officials that their behavior is being monitored and recorded. 2. Provide an area for trolley assistants to line-up and help the passengers *only if* requested. Otherwise, they should not enter the baggage claim area. I have not seen trolley assistants in any other airport in any country except for Bangalore where they roam around with complete authority and harass the passengers. I understand that there is a need for one or two airport employees to set aside unclaimed baggage from the conveyor. But, those employees should be different from the trolley assistants. 3. Put up a public notice at the customs channels with the anti-corruption vigilance officers names, addresses, phone numbers and email ids so that they can be contacted in case of an unruly behavior by the customs officials on duty. It is scary that corrupt officials like Mr. Giridharan who are harassing passengers with demands for bribes are holding the passengers’ passports as well as all other baggage. Please do not hesitate to contact me at <email-address> if you need any further information regarding this case. I will be disclosing this complaint letter to the public this via other channels as well as blogs. Thanks for your attention and hope that we can make Bangalore International Airport better. Best Regards, Was this information helpful? No (0) Yes (0)

Title/Headline: Airtel Iptv — poor service, poor quality, no signal , waiting signal
Full Text: Dear Sir, I enrolled for Airtel IPTV Service on 11 Jan 2011 vide at my residence in Sukhdev Vihar, New Delhi. For the installation of service, I’ve paid Rs.1750/- as installation charge with a monthly pack of Rs.999 per month which includes unlimited broadband at 512kbps speed and a landline connection. My experience so far has been VERY FRUSTATING, full of agony, mental torture and all my communication is affected which has deeply hurt my family, my aged parents and my profession/patients. The service worked initially for some days only. But it starts hanging the pictures and No network on 25 Mar 2011 after my complaint on 27 Mar 2011 repeated on[protected]complain No. 44597622 and 44821264 respectively), Airtel Replace my Modem But problem not resolved. Since 27 Mar 2011 the service has hanging problem and no network till Now,  Me and my friend's repeated calls to Airtel service centers are either disconnected by IVR or not logged at all. I am always told that either the Server is down or the Server is getting upgraded. I’ve been talking to Airtel technical agent and they suggest me to remove all connection from Modem and Connect again after a mint. When I contact to Mr. Gaurav[protected] – system installer) almost daily (for last 4 days) to get the service working but everyday he tells me that this are have some network issue it will be resolved soon. Due to this problem I have not paid airtel bill (No.[protected] Dated 12 Apr 2011, Amount: 1101.90INR) Because I want to remove 12 days chanrges from this bill , In these days I have not used Airtel Services. 1.     I request hanging and no signal problem to  airtel by  Mail to [protected]@in.airtel.com on 9 may 2011 After no response from airtel 2.     I repeat mail to 121 for disconnection of services on 10 may 2011 , When I was trying to reach airtel by phone my phone was disconnected after 15 mint hold on IVR. 3.     I gain call to airtel by phone on 12 may 2011 against service request No. 46227820 , But No one come for service/Disconnection from Airtel. , 4.     I repeat my complain to 121 again on 13 may 2011 to disconnect service (Request No.[protected] After my 4 complain within 4 days Mr. Gaurav[protected] – system installer) called me and told me that my wiring is defective so they have to install new wiring but they don’t have stock of those wires so I have to wait. See attached pic of last month for your refrence. Despite of solving my issue airtel continue to generate another bill on 12 may 2011 of amount: 1176.90 with a late payment fee of INR 75/-) Now airtel want me to pay INR 2356 But, I want to Remove 45 Days Charges from this period, Otherwise I will not pay any panny to airtel. If the service was launched recently, I fail to understand the need for a server upgrade. Why has the service been commercial when the basic infrastructure is not ready to support the triple service. My family members are deprived of their entertainment needs as the TV is down. My kids school assignments are affected as they cannot do their research on internet and they have to spend money on cyber cafes and a family member has to accompany them for the same which causes lot of inconvenience and has upset the family schedule. My profession is affected since I cannot contact my patients for their problems or after-care since last 45 days which is adding to my loss of income. By subscribing to this Airtel service, I seem to have enrolled for agony, if nothing else. I want Airtel to restore my service, confirm that the service will run uninterrupted as the whole communication gets affected with this service, refund me the installation amount and compensate me for the denial of services, false hope and false promises, non-functioning of Telephone, Broadband and TV and for the harassment, mental agony and loss of income it has caused to me, my aged parents, my kids and other family members. Also, Airtel should be directed to put in a geographic redundant system so there are no further excuses like service upgrades the whole communication needs are affected by an untested system/service. Allowing such services on one pipe is catastrophic itself in nature and such services let Airtel monepolize and take the customer to ransom by not committing to restoration of services. No Telecommunication services should be allowed to run if the Operator cannot restore it in 2-3 hrs.

I was so shocked looking at it. I again reached out to them on the same email chain and explained the same situation. But this time they are not at all trying to understand and keep on asking me for money and pay the bill. I simply cannot pay the bill or amount so huge for something i never used. They are accusing me o[censored]sing data and sending sms or receiving call which i never did. I know how to use my phone and how to turn off the data in phone itself. Please help me resolve this case as my intention was just to keep my sim active and nothing else but they are charging me for so many things and for such a huge amount which i am not capable of paying in the first place and this is looting. Title/Headline: Future Bazaar — NON DELIVERY OF ORDERED PRODUCTS
Full Text: Dear Sir, An imposter has fraudulently used my debit card (issued by Indian overseas bank) on 21/10/10 for three transactions to buy articles online from Future Bazaar.com.  When I got my passbook updated on 23/10/10, I noticed these transactions and immediately requested Indian Overseas Bank to block my card and also get details of the transactions.  Preliminary inquiry by the Bank revealed that the transactions were linked to my debit card number and were done online.  But I had already lost Rs.24,650/- due to these fake transactions and this has caused enormous emotional and financial strain to me. I tried calling Future Bazaar immediately  but in Mumbai the calls get diverted to some remote call center located in suburbs.  Though the customer support executives were patient and supportive, they could not give me a concrete solution or connect me to the main office of Future Bazaar where I could actually lodge my complaint. I did not have any  order number or other details in the bank statement but internet searches revealed that the transaction amounts matched exactly with those of mobile phones and other items.  Future Bazaar’s customer support staff just kept telling me to mail the documents and also gave me the address and phone number of their office but the interlocutor at their office in Mumbai central were indifferent and not forthcoming.  I will try again to call on 25 Oct 2010 but I believe my efforts would be in vain-because all that the people have to say is it is all “online”. Title/Headline: Airtel — Airtel Broadband fraud - undue payment charges after disconnection
Full Text: Please beware of the Airtel Broadband fraud done by the company in the pretext of collecting undue non-payment charges. I had a Airtel Broadband connection[protected] in my wife's name, in my old residence in Malad West Mumbai, for which i had given a shifting request to my current residence in Goregaon (W) in the month of August, 2010. After a couple of days, Airtel informed me that the connection is not available in the new location, and hence, i gave a Disconnection request to them. After this i got a few calls from them informing me about the service non availability again and again. On every occasion, i informed them that i had disconnected the service already, and they must take back the instrument and send me the final bill. The following month, i got a call from the billing dept asking for the pending payment. I promptly made a check payment, which their personnel collected from my place. The lady in the billing dept categorically confirmed that it's the full and final payment for my account, and henceforth there wouldnt be any bill against the account. Suddenly, after a gap of six months, on 26th Feb, 2011,  i got a call from someone named Devanshu Patel ([protected]) - claiming to be a Munshi in a Delhi Civil court - who informed that there was a legal notice being sent to me for which we didnt respond. When asked, he confirmed the address, i.e. my former residence address, where the notice was sent. He also told me to get in touch with the lawyer NK Singh, who it seemed, sent the notice. Mr Patel insisted that i resolve the issue with the lawyer or else a Civil case would be registered in the court. Shocked and absolutely clueless, i got in touch with the lawyer. Mr.Singh told me that I had Rs.1485/- to pay to Bharti Airtel Broadband service, and the company had sent out the notice to recover the amount. Despite telling him that I was being wrongly billed for a month, and i already made the final payment, he wouldnt listen. He told me I had to pay the amount immediately if i want to stop the legal proceedings. And he gave me a legal id[protected]. Both Mr Patel and Singh asked me to make the payment within a hour or so to avoid the proceedings. Feeling so helpless, i had no option but to go to the nearest Airtel shop in Lokhandwala, Andheri to pay the amount. After paying, i called up Mr Patel and Singh both to confirm the payment, and provided them with the details. I asked Mr Singh to send me the documents pertaining to the closure / settlement of the case. He took my address and assured that he'd send the 'khareej-nama' (out of court settlement) to me via courier as soon as possible. After all these, I called up Airtel customer care (121) and complained about the wrong billing, and the harassment i just had gone through. They esacalated the case, and one Mr Raghavendra from the escalation dept got in touch with me. After seeing all the records, he admitted that it's a mistake from Airtel's side as they took 15 days to process the shifting request for which the account remained active despite me cancelling the same. hence i was charged for the month, and the company kept sending bills to my old address, even though they were fully aware that the i had shifted from the address. In 6 months, the amount, with recurring interest and subsequent fines, went upto Rs 1485 from Rs 900, and then they had sent me a legal notice to pay the amount. He assured me that i need not worry, and it would be resolved by March 1st week, and all the needful would be done; they would get in touch for the same. But, unfortunately, they never got in touch, and nothing had been done! In the mean time, i found out that there are many similar cases being reported on several internet sites. There are several posts about how the customers were trapped by the company in exactly the similar manner i had experienced. You can search google with "Airtel lawyer NK Singh" to see those complaints. Meanwhile almost 10 days went past, and there was no document from Mr Singh. So, i called up Mr Patel and NK Singh. After many attempts also, i couldnt contact Mr Patel, who simply doesn't pick up the calls, or the number is switched off. However, I was able to reach Mr Singh. but, to my surprise, he simply denied such calling ever took place at all. He refused to send me the necessary documents, and was extremely rude. I spoke to several persons in that Law firm that Mr Singh claims to work for Airtel -- Naved Khan, Nk Singh, Prashant Verma, who keep denying any such incident, and tell me that they give a damn. I feel extremely dejected and annoyed by such malpractice being adapted by such a reputed company like Airtel. While i am exploring all my options to bring them to justice, i want to warn all of you who are reading this to be fully aware of such fraud/scam that Airtel is doing to collect undue amounts from their customers. - Regards, Amit Bhattacharya

StructuredData.Title/Headline: Airtel — Airtel Broadband fraud - undue payment charges after disconnection
